Name: Zhuu's II - Better Wells
Author: yhh2324
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Better Well[/b][/size]
[i]Zhuu Studio[/i][/center]

Upgrades the vanilla farm well through Robin, the same way a coop becomes a deluxe coop. Two new buildings: a blue-roof Advanced Well and a gold-roof Ultimate Well.

[size=4][b]Normal well[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]After a normal rain or thunderstorm, outdoor tilled soil stays wet one extra day in sun or wind.[/*]
[*]Unfertilized wild trees grow faster, including palm trees.[/*]
[*]Uses the game's wild-tree data, so SVE birch and fir are included automatically.[/*]
[*]Does not affect fruit trees, fertilized wild trees, or garden pots.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Advanced Well[/b][/size]
Robin upgrades an existing well in place.
[list]
[*]Cost: 15,000g + 10 Iron Bars + 10 Gold Bars[/*]
[*]Build time: 1 day (normal-well effects stay active during construction)[/*]
[*]Newly tilled outdoor soil is watered immediately[/*]
[*]Flowers stay watered[/*]
[*]Unfertilized fiber seeds and seasonal wild seeds have a 25% chance to gain one extra growth day[/*]
[*]Includes every normal-well effect[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Ultimate Well[/b][/size]
Robin upgrades an Advanced Well in place.
[list]
[*]Cost: 100,000g + 20 Solar Essence + 40 Aquamarine[/*]
[*]Build time: 1 day (advanced-well effects stay active during construction)[/*]
[*]Automatically waters trellis crops and other crops you cannot walk through (beans, grapes, and similar)[/*]
[*]Outdoor fertilizer is kept when the season changes from spring through winter[/*]
[*]Winter 28 → Spring 1 still clears fertilizer like vanilla[/*]
[*]Includes every normal and advanced effect[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Rules[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Wells do not stack. Only the highest tier on the farm applies.[/*]
[*]Garden pots are never affected.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.5.2+.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
Drop the BetterWells folder into Stardew Valley/Mods and launch through SMAPI.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Made by Zhuu Studio.

[center][size=5][b]更好的水井 Better Well[/b][/size]
[i]Zhuu Studio[/i][/center]

给原版水井增加两级原地升级，流程和大鸡舍一样，由罗宾施工。新建筑为蓝色屋顶的高级水井，以及金色屋顶的顶级水井。

[size=4][b]普通水井[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]普通雨或雷雨之后的晴天、风天，室外耕地额外保持湿润一天。[/*]
[*]未施树肥的野树成长更快，包含棕榈树。[/*]
[*]读取游戏野树数据，自动兼容 SVE 的白桦和冷杉。[/*]
[*]不影响果树、已施树肥的野树和花盆。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]高级水井[/b][/size]
罗宾对现有普通水井原地升级。
[list]
[*]费用：15000 金 + 铁锭 10 + 金锭 10[/*]
[*]工期 1 天（施工当天仍是普通水井效果）[/*]
[*]新开垦的室外耕地立即湿润[/*]
[*]花卉自动保持湿润[/*]
[*]未施肥的纤维种子和季节种子，每个正常成长日有 25% 概率额外成长一天[/*]
[*]包含普通水井的全部效果[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]顶级水井[/b][/size]
罗宾对现有高级水井继续原地升级。
[list]
[*]费用：100000 金 + 太阳精华 20 + 海蓝宝石 40[/*]
[*]工期 1 天（施工当天仍是高级水井效果）[/*]
[*]自动灌溉棚架作物，以及玩家无法走上去的作物（青豆、葡萄等）[/*]
[*]室外肥料在春→夏、夏→秋、秋→冬时保留[/*]
[*]冬 28 到次年春 1 仍按原版清除肥料[/*]
[*]包含普通水井和高级水井的全部效果[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]规则[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]多座水井不叠加，全场只按最高等级计算。[/*]
[*]花盆始终不受影响。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]需求[/b][/size]
星露谷物语 1.6.15+，SMAPI 4.5.2+。

[size=4][b]安装[/b][/size]
把 BetterWells 文件夹放入 Mods，用 SMAPI 启动。

[size=4][b]制作[/b][/size]
Zhuu Studio
